messages:
Maya: Quick UX/accessibility callout on the rollout inspector. VoiceOver is announcing the canary pill and then the collapsed row label, so SR users hear 'Canary 7%... Canary 7%' twice. :thinking_face: Leo: Repro on macOS + Safari. Seems like we have an aria-live string on the pill and a separate live label on the collapsed container. Priya: I couldn't repro on NVDA. Likely VoiceOver focus/announce order. Arun: Suggestion: keep a single aria-live owned by the pill component and mark the duplicate collapsed label aria-hidden="true". Minimal DOM change and should stop the duplication. Tess: Also microcopy: action currently says "Pause rollout" but product intent is to pause only the canary variant. Recommend changing to "Pause canary" and update tooltip to match. Maya: Agreed. Small copy mismatch caused confusion in a demo yesterday. Priya: Quick snippet to try: ``` Canary allocation updated to 7%
Canary 7%
``` Leo: Also found a bug: when scrubbing timeline and clicking rollback, the confirmation modal displays the current time instead of the selected snapshot time. That confused QA. Arun: That explains the demo confusion. Modal is using Date.now() instead of selectedSnapshot.timeISO. I'll patch and add a unit test. Tess: UX copy for modal: header should read "Rollback to snapshot v2.0.1 — 2025-08-14 09:22 UTC" and primary CTA "Rollback to snapshot" (avoid generic "Confirm"). Add aria-describedby for the warning text: "This reverts traffic and restarts variant pods. Metrics are preserved." Maya: Please put the live-region de-dupe behind a feature flag and include VoiceOver/NVDA test steps in the PR checklist. I'll run VoiceOver test once flag is on. AccessBot: Accessibility scan queued: AR-2025-46 duplicate live region (severity: medium). Priya: I'll own the PR: 1) de-dupe live region + aria-hidden, 2) change button/tooltip copy to "Pause canary", 3) fix focus ring for tiny variant pills in high contrast. Assigning @Arun for modal timestamp fix. Maya: Thanks all 60a
